name: aliases
code: held=groups; assert scene is model and scene.mesh is mesh and scene.groups is groups; existing=groups[0]; ef=existing.mesh.faces[0]

name: create
check: assert groups[-1] is g and g.mesh is m and m.faces[0] is f

name: undo
check: assert g not in groups and g.mesh is m and m.faces[0] is f

name: redo
check: assert groups[-1] is g and held is groups and g.mesh is m

name: undo-shared
check: assert g2 not in groups and g in groups

name: redo-shared
check: assert g not in groups and g2 in groups and g2.mesh is m
